plasmaGenerators.name: Commercial Industrial APMPJ Torch Array (4x Torches, 2.45 GHz, 3.0 kW Solid-State, Automatic Impedance Matching)
plasmaGenerators.classification: Continuous Industrial Atmospheric Pressure Microwave Plasma Jet (FDA 21 CFR § 179.26 / cGMP)
plasmaGenerators.coolingType: Closed-Loop DI Water Jacket (2.5 L/min at 18°C)
plasmaGenerators.description: High-power industrial atmospheric pressure microwave plasma jet array featuring solid-state semiconductor microwave generators, real-time dual-stub motor-driven impedance matchers, and water-cooled coax resonators. Generates dense non-thermal plasma plumes with electron temperatures Te of 1.5–2.5 eV while maintaining bulk gas temperatures under 65°C.

plasmaGenerators.name: Continuous Wide-Web Microwave Linear Plasma Curtain Skid (2.45 GHz, 2.5 kW, Dielectric Slit Resonator)
plasmaGenerators.classification: Continuous Roll-to-Roll Packaging Sterilization System (3-A Sanitary / CE-PED)
plasmaGenerators.coolingType: Forced Chilled Air & Copper Heat Sink
plasmaGenerators.description: Continuous linear slit plasma curtain applicator designed for roll-fed multi-layer aseptic packaging webs and carton foils. Employs a precision synthetic quartz dielectric window across a 600 mm line width, delivering uniform reactive oxygen species and vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) photons at line speeds up to 2.5 m/s.

plasmaGenerators.name: Precision Multi-Nozzle Micro-Jet Plasma Applicator (2.45 GHz, 1.2 kW, Low-Temperature Capillary)
plasmaGenerators.classification: Pharmaceutical Sterile Barrier Decontaminator (ISO 11137 / ISO 14937 / cGMP)
plasmaGenerators.description: Cleanroom-compatible multi-capillary microwave plasma applicator engineered for decontaminating delicate pharmaceutical pre-fill syringe barrels, vial necks, and thermoformed blister pockets. Minimizes heat transfer to keep substrate surface temperature rise under 8°C.

plasmaGenerators.name: Compromised Unmatched Resonator with Quartz Window Carbonization (Dielectric Arcing & Severe Overheating)
plasmaGenerators.classification: HAZARDOUS / NON-COMPLIANT (Thermal Runaway, Polymer Scorching & Microwave Radiation Leakage)
plasmaGenerators.description: Severely degraded microwave cavity suffering from heavy soot/carbon deposits on quartz windows, mistuned impedance matching, and coolant failure. Creates parasitic thermal electric arcs, localized substrate burning, and unsafe microwave radiation leakage violating OSHA and FCC limits.

workingGasMixtures.name: Argon / Oxygen Process Gas (97% Ar / 3% O2) - High ROS & UV-C Radical Flux
workingGasMixtures.primaryActiveSpecies: Singlet Oxygen (1O2), Hydroxyl Radicals (•OH), Ozone (O3), Vacuum UV (180-260 nm)
workingGasMixtures.description: Standard high-efficacy mixture for rapid spore decontamination. Low ionization energy of argon allows stable microwave ignition at low power, while oxygen dissociation generates high densities of ground-state atomic oxygen and ozone, achieving rapid cell wall oxidation and etching.

workingGasMixtures.name: Nitrogen / Clean Dry Air (CDA) (80% N2 / 20% Air) - High RNS & Economic Web Sanitization
workingGasMixtures.primaryActiveSpecies: Nitric Oxide (•NO), Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Peroxynitrite (ONOO-), UV-A/B bands
workingGasMixtures.description: Economical gas blend for high-speed continuous packaging lines. Abundant nitrogen radicals and peroxynitrite precursors inflict heavy oxidative stress on bacterial DNA and lipid membranes without expensive noble carrier gases.

workingGasMixtures.name: Ultra-High Purity Pure Argon (99.999% Ar) - VUV Photonic Etching & Non-Oxidative Activation
workingGasMixtures.primaryActiveSpecies: Argon Excimer Exciplex (Ar2*), Resonant VUV Photons (106.7 nm, 126 nm), High-Energy Electrons (Te > 2.8 eV)
workingGasMixtures.description: Generates intense vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) photons through argon dimer de-excitation. Breaks carbon-carbon and carbon-hydrogen surface bonds directly via photochemical scission without oxidizing delicate functional polymers or food aromatics.

workingGasMixtures.name: Helium / Water Vapor Cold Plasma (99.6% He / 0.4% H2O) - Ultra-Cold High-•OH Radical Jet
workingGasMixtures.primaryActiveSpecies: Hydroxyl Radicals (•OH), Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2) Vapor, Metastable He*(23S)
workingGasMixtures.description: Ultra-low temperature plasma optimized for heat-sensitive biopolymer packaging and living plant tissue. Superior thermal conductivity of helium dissipates thermal energy rapidly, while water dissociation creates potent •OH radical flux that dismantles microbial capsids at temperatures below 38°C.

workingGasMixtures.name: Unfiltered Humid Ambient Air (High Particulate & Humidity Contamination)
workingGasMixtures.primaryActiveSpecies: Corrosive Nitric Acid (HNO3) Vapors, Uncontrolled Ozone, Thermal Filamentary Spark Arcs
workingGasMixtures.description: UNSAFE gas environment. Uncontrolled moisture and airborne dust cause impedance mismatch, quenching the diffuse glow into destructive filamentary sparks that burn substrates and generate copious toxic nitrogen dioxide and nitric acid aerosol.
